about_the_game:
Flamboyant? Absolutely. Subtle? Never heard of it.

Strut into New Yolk with enough pink to blind a cop and enough style to make a pelican weep. The Flamingo Pack is your all-access pass to outrageous confidence and questionable taste... the good kind.

With this pack you'll get access to:

  • Flamingo Skin: A full-body pink explosion with a majestic beak and even more majestic attitude. No feathers out of place. No apologies either.

  • Golden Geometry Earrings: Precision meets pizzazz. These angular beauties scream "I do math… but fashionably."

  • Two-Tone Headbow: A soft, pastel pop of charm. Sweet, simple, and just the right amount of smug.
